|strategy=By Joe Alread (joea@decipher.com)<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/battleplan.html</ref>

[[Battle Plan]] takes the concept of balanced decks to a whole new level. For a player to have to use 3 Force to Force drain you somewhere is a large expense, and 3 Force that could have been used somewhere else. This hits hardest against those trying to drain you fast at a lot of ground locations, such as with an Operative deck or an ISB "drop and drain" type of deck. Conceptually, if your Force draining for free while your opponent isn't, you should definitely have the edge. The price? Some deck balance.
